description: Implementation of ContentDao interface for accessing Content entities in the database, including methods for listing, retrieving by code, ID, language, and URL, with query construction using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: ContentDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Content entity, providing methods for querying content data based on various parameters.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by type, store, and optionally language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Returns a list of ContentDescription objects (names and URLs) for content filtered by type, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object by its code and store.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its ID and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object by code, store, and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
